# m.partners.etf_global.constituents

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The holdings of US-listed ETFs from ETF Global, one row per fund, date, and holding.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.partners.etf_global.constituents(symbols=None, *, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None, on_error=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Symbol`, `EffectiveDate`, `ProcessedDate` and `ConstituentRank`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | ETF tickers. Leave it out for every fund; `dm.ALL` is refused. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Any field of the rows, such as `"weight"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. A watchlist's `fetch()` caps every request instead. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"effective_date": "2026-09-18"}`. Keys: `composite_ticker_gt`, `composite_ticker_gte`, `composite_ticker_lt`, `composite_ticker_lte`, `constituent_ticker`, `constituent_ticker_any_of`, `constituent_ticker_gt`, `constituent_ticker_gte`, `constituent_ticker_lt`, `constituent_ticker_lte`, `effective_date`, `effective_date_gt`, `effective_date_gte`, `effective_date_lt`, `effective_date_lte`, `figi`, `figi_any_of`, `figi_gt`, `figi_gte`, `figi_lt`, `figi_lte`, `isin`, `isin_any_of`, `isin_gt`, `isin_gte`, `isin_lt`, `isin_lte`, `processed_date`, `processed_date_gt`, `processed_date_gte`, `processed_date_lt`, `processed_date_lte`, `sedol`, `sedol_any_of`, `sedol_gt`, `sedol_gte`, `sedol_lt`, `sedol_lte`, `us_code`, `us_code_any_of`, `us_code_gt`, `us_code_gte`, `us_code_lt`, `us_code_lte`. |
| [`on_error`](README.md#on_error) | What a bad symbol or row does in this call (`dm.ErrorPolicy`). None, the default, takes each cause from the session's `MassiveConfig.on_error`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | ETF Constituents (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| ETF Global Constituents | Updated daily, All history |
| ETF Global Constituents Business | Updated daily, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From REST `composite_ticker`: "The stock ticker symbol of the ETF that holds these constituent securities." |
| `AssetClass` | String | The broad category of asset type, such as Equity, Corporate Bond, Municipal Bond, etc. |
| `ConstituentName` | String | The full company or security name of the constituent holding. |
| `ConstituentRank` | long | The rank of this constituent within the ETF for a given effective_date, ordered by weight (descending), market_value (descending), and constituent_ticker (ascending). A rank of 1 indicates the largest holding. |
| `ConstituentTicker` | String | The stock ticker symbol of the individual security held within the ETF. |
| `CountryOfExchange` | String | The country where the exchange that lists this constituent security is located. |
| `CurrencyTraded` | String | The local currency in which this constituent security is denominated and traded. |
| `EffectiveDate` | String | The date showing when the information was accurate or valid; some issuers, such as Vanguard, release their data on a delay, so the effective_date can be several weeks earlier than the processed_date. |
| `Exchange` | String | The name of the stock exchange where this constituent security is primarily traded. |
| `Figi` | String | The Financial Instrument Global Identifier, an open standard for uniquely identifying financial instruments. |
| `Isin` | String | The International Securities Identification Number, a global standard for identifying securities. |
| `MarketValue` | double | The total market value of this constituent position held by the ETF. |
| `ProcessedDate` | String | The date showing when ETF Global received and processed the data. |
| `SecurityType` | String | The specific classification of security type using ETF Global's taxonomy, such as Common Equity, Domestic, Global, etc. |
| `Sedol` | String | The Stock Exchange Daily Official List code, primarily used for securities trading in the UK. |
| `SharesHeld` | double | The number of shares of this constituent security that the ETF currently owns. |
| `UsCode` | String | A unique identifier code for the constituent security in US markets. |
| `Weight` | double | The constituent's weight in the ETF's portfolio, as a decimal fraction (0.0789 = 7.89%). Short positions are negative. For most funds the weights sum to about 1; leveraged and inverse funds vary. A few constituents have no weight, so a sum can fall short. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
